title: Do You Want to Eat Something?
synopsis:
Anne is unwell, and Li Xiaobei takes her to see a doctor. Anne and Li Xiaobei chat at the hospital entrance.
In this lesson, you will learn how to ask about the health of a sick friend and express your concern for them.

fullText.simplified:
你想不想吃点儿东西？

李小北：Anne，这是你的药，医生说每天都要吃。
Anne：好的，我知道了。
李小北：医生还说要好好休息，晚上早点儿睡觉。
Anne：好的，我会好好休息的。
李小北：想爸爸妈妈的时候，也可以打电话给我，我会去看你。
Anne：小北，你真好，谢谢你来看我，也谢谢你和我来医院。
李小北：不客气，我们是朋友呢！你累不累？要不要休息一下？
Anne：不累。我每天都运动，身体很好的。
李小北：现在你生病了，身体要休息。
Anne：好吧，我听你的。
李小北：你还没吃午饭，现在想不想吃点儿东西？
Anne：我想吃面条，你吃不吃？我们一起去吃吧！
李小北：好，我们一起去吃面条。
Anne：我还想吃羊肉，可以吗？
李小北：羊肉不太好，等你的病好了再吃吧！
fullText.traditional:
你想不想吃點兒東西？

李小北：Anne，這是你的藥，醫生說每天都要吃。
Anne：好的，我知道了。
李小北：醫生還說要好好休息，晚上早點兒睡覺。
Anne：好的，我會好好休息的。
李小北：想爸爸媽媽的時候，也可以打電話給我，我會去看你。
Anne：小北，你真好，謝謝你來看我，也謝謝你和我來醫院。
李小北：不客氣，我們是朋友呢！你累不累？要不要休息一下？
Anne：不累。我每天都運動，身體很好的。
李小北：現在你生病了，身體要休息。
Anne：好吧，我聽你的。
李小北：你還沒吃午飯，現在想不想吃點兒東西？
Anne：我想吃麵條，你吃不吃？我們一起去吃吧！
李小北：好，我們一起去吃麵條。
Anne：我還想吃羊肉，可以嗎？
李小北：羊肉不太好，等你的病好了再吃吧！

sentence_translations: Do You Want to Eat Something?
Li Xiaobei: Anne, this is your medicine. The doctor said you have to take it every day.
Li Xiaobei: The doctor also said to rest well and go to bed early at night.
Anne: Okay, I will rest well.
Li Xiaobei: When you miss your dad and mom, you can also call me, and I will come and see you.
Anne: Xiaobei, you are so kind. Thank you for coming to see me, and also thank you for coming with me to the hospital.
Li Xiaobei: You’re welcome. We are friends after all! Are you tired? Do you want to rest a little?
Anne: I’m not tired. I exercise every day and I am in very good health.
Li Xiaobei: You are sick right now. Your body needs a rest.
Anne: Okay, I’ll listen to you.
Li Xiaobei: You haven’t eaten lunch yet. Do you want to eat something now?
Anne: I want to eat noodles. Do you want some? Let’s go eat together!
Li Xiaobei: Sure, let’s go eat noodles together.
Anne: I also want to eat mutton. Is that okay?
Li Xiaobei: Mutton is not very suitable. Wait until you’re better before eating it!
